easy.def: The part of your face you use to see.
examples: I close my eye.
She has blue eyes.
A cat has two eyes.

more.def: One of the two body parts in the face that a person or animal uses to see.
examples: The owl has large eyes that help it see in the dark.
I got a bit of sand in my eye at the beach.
He rubbed his eyes when he woke up.

easy.def: The whole round part of your eye.
examples: The eyeball is round.
I touched my eyeball.
The eyeball moves.

more.def: The round part of the eye that sits in the eye socket.
examples: The eyeball is round and moves in every direction.
Dust got into my eyeball.
The doctor looked at the eyeball.

easy.def: The line of short hairs above your eye.
examples: He raised his eyebrow.
My eyebrow is dark.
Sweat ran down his eyebrow.

more.def: The strip of short hair that grows above each eye.
examples: She raised an eyebrow when she heard the surprising news.
Sweat dripped from his eyebrow as he ran the last lap.
Thick eyebrows help keep rain and sweat out of your eyes.
I got an eyeful.
She got an eyeful of dust.
We got an eyeful of the show.

more.def: A good look at something, or a speck in the eye.
examples: We got an eyeful of the beautiful view.
A passerby got an eyeful of the spectacular fireworks.
The kids got an eyeful of the huge cake.
He wears eyeglasses.
My eyeglasses are on the table.
She put on her eyeglasses.

more.def: Glasses with lenses that help a person see better.
examples: He put on his eyeglasses to read the board.
My eyeglasses slipped down my nose.
She cleaned her eyeglasses with a soft cloth.

easy.def: One of the little hairs around your eye.
examples: An eyelash fell out.
I have long eyelashes.
She made a wish on an eyelash.

more.def: One of the short hairs that grow along the edge of the eyelid and help keep dust out of your eyes.
examples: An eyelash fell onto her cheek, and she made a wish.
Eyelashes help keep dust out of your eyes.
The camel has long, thick eyelashes.

easy.def: The skin that closes over your eye.
examples: Close your eyelid.
My eyelid is heavy.
The eyelid blinked.

more.def: The fold of skin that closes over your eye to protect it and keep it wet.
examples: My eyelids felt heavy when I was sleepy.
The eyelid closes over the eye every time you blink.
The frog has a clear extra eyelid.
She wore eyeliner.
The eyeliner is black.
Mom put on eyeliner.

more.def: A kind of makeup that is drawn along the edge of the eyelid.
examples: She put on black eyeliner for the play.
The actor wore eyeliner on stage.
Mom used a brown pencil to put on eyeliner.
I have good eyesight.
Her eyesight is poor.
The eagle has sharp eyesight.

more.def: The ability to see, or how well a person can see.
examples: An eagle has sharp eyesight and can spot a mouse from far away.
Grandpa's eyesight is poor, so he wears glasses.
Reading in dim light can hurt your eyesight.

easy.def: An ugly thing to look at.
examples: The old shed is an eyesore.
The eyesore was ugly.
A messy yard is an eyesore.

more.def: Something that is unpleasant to look at.
examples: The old, broken shed was an eyesore.
The litter was an eyesore in the park.
Neighbors painted over the eyesore.

easy.def: A person who saw what happened.
examples: The eyewitness told the police.
An eyewitness saw the crash.
The eyewitness described it.

more.def: A person who saw an event happen with their own eyes and can tell about it.
examples: The eyewitness told the police what happened.
An eyewitness saw the car go by.
The eyewitness described the scene.
